# `notificationService.notify(notification)`

Displays a global toast notification to the user. This is a non-blocking UI element ideal for providing feedback on asynchronous actions, warnings, or general information.

---
## Parameter

The function takes a single `notification` object as its parameter with the following properties:

| Property | Type | Required? | Description |

| **`alertTitle`** | `string` | Yes | The main title displayed at the top of the notification. |

| **`alertDescription`** | `string` | Yes | The body text or main message of the notification. |

| **`alertType`** | `string` | Yes | Determines the style and color. Common values: `'SUCCESS'`, `'ERROR'`, `'INFO'`, `'WARNING'`. |

| `displayActionButton` | `boolean` | No | Set to `true` to show the main, styled action button. Defaults to `false`. |

| `actionButtonLabel` | `string` | If `displayActionButton` is true | The text label for the main action button. |

| `onActionButtonClick` | `function` | If `displayActionButton` is true | The callback function to execute when the action button is clicked. |

| `displayActionText` | `boolean` | No | Set to `true` to show a secondary, text-based action link. Defaults to `false`. |

| `actionTextLabel` | `string` | If `displayActionText` is true | The text for the secondary action link. |

| `onActionTextClick` | `function` | If `displayActionText` is true | The callback function to execute when the action text is clicked. |

---
## Examples

### 1. Simple Informational Notification

This example shows a basic notification with no actions.
```javascript
notificationService.notify({
    alertType: 'INFO',
    alertTitle: 'Update In Progress',
    alertDescription: 'Your profile is being updated in the background.'
});
```
